description: 模型生成及QQ任务的固定脱敏原因；仅允许这些代码进入消息界面，不展示底层错误原文。

authentication_source_expired.zh-CN: 源登录已过期或即将过期，请先刷新Codex登录
authentication_source_expired.en: The source sign-in has expired or is expiring; refresh the Codex sign-in

authentication_source_unavailable.zh-CN: 源登录不可用，请检查Codex登录
authentication_source_unavailable.en: The source sign-in is unavailable; check the Codex sign-in

authentication_account_mismatch.zh-CN: 源登录账号或主体不一致，已停止使用该模型登录
authentication_account_mismatch.en: The source account or identity does not match; use of this model sign-in is stopped

authentication_sync_conflict.zh-CN: 登录信息在同步期间变化，已停止覆盖，请稍后重试
authentication_sync_conflict.en: Sign-in data changed during sync; replacement was stopped. Try again later

authentication_sync_failed.zh-CN: 登录快照同步失败，已停止使用该模型登录
authentication_sync_failed.en: Sign-in snapshot synchronization failed; use of this model sign-in is stopped

authentication_sync_pending.zh-CN: 登录快照等待同步，请稍后重试
authentication_sync_pending.en: The sign-in snapshot is waiting to synchronize; try again shortly

authentication_expired.zh-CN: 登录快照已过期，请重新连接现有模型登录
authentication_expired.en: The sign-in snapshot has expired; reconnect the existing model sign-in

authentication_failed.zh-CN: 模型服务身份验证失败

reasoning_unsupported.zh-CN: 模型不支持当前推理参数
reasoning_unsupported.en: The model does not support the reasoning settings

rate_limited.en: The model service is rate limited

context_exceeded.en: The model context limit was exceeded

runtime_unavailable.zh-CN: 本地模型运行组件不可用
runtime_unavailable.en: A local model runtime component is unavailable

runtime_type_error.zh-CN: 本地模型运行时发生类型错误
runtime_type_error.en: A type error occurred in the local model runtime

empty_response.en: The model returned no reply text

incomplete_response.en: The model reply did not complete

local_backend_error.zh-CN: 本地模型服务执行失败

configuration_changed.zh-CN: 任务期间配置或来源已变化
configuration_changed.en: Settings or source data changed during the task

permission_denied.zh-CN: 当前权限不允许此操作
permission_denied.en: Current permissions do not allow this operation

cleanup_required.zh-CN: 临时模型会话清理未确认
cleanup_required.en: Temporary model session cleanup is unconfirmed

details_unavailable.zh-CN: 旧记录未保留详细原因
details_unavailable.en: The older record contains no detailed reason
